items.text: Left side rail — a new optional navigation layout: a 44 px vertical icon strip on the left edge replaces the floating bottom button bar. Select Side rail (left) in Config → General → Layout → Button bar position.
Button order — rail top to bottom: + add bookmark; spacer; > search · ? finders · : commands · * recent · / tag cloud; separator; ! cheatsheet · ★ what's new pinned at the bottom.

Tag cloud in the rail — the / button sits directly under * recent in the toolbar flow (not a separate fixed corner FAB). The word-cloud modal opens to the right of the rail and grows with your tags instead of clipping with a false scrollbar.

Unified cell style — every rail button is a 44 × 44 px square cell with no border-radius, transparent background, and a centred icon — matching the ★ what's new button. Border-top separators mark section boundaries. Hover slides the icon 2 px right with a subtle accent tint.
Tooltip placement — on side-rail, button tooltips (including /) appear to the right of the rail instead of above the button.
Content shift & mobile fallback — the dashboard grid shifts right by 44 px to clear the rail. On mobile (≤768 px) the layout automatically reverts to a centred bottom bar.

Page tab labels — side-rail mode no longer hides page numbers and names in the header tab bar (font-size: 0 dots-only layout removed); icons, colour dots, and labels match the default page tabs (respects Show page names in tabs).
Grouped bulk toasts — rapid tag-filter move/delete and multi-bookmark category moves coalesce into one toast (e.g. 3 bookmarks moved) instead of stacking several messages.
G + P jump to pinned — after G, press P to select the first pinned bookmark on the page. G + 1–9 still jumps to the nth category or smart collection.
Cheat sheet — side rail — when the side rail is active, the keyboard cheat sheet (! / F1) adds a Layout (side rail) section (tab order, page-tab scroll, :buttonbar).
prefers-reduced-motion — additional coverage for bookmark open flash, promo balloons, and config tab fade-in; honours Reduce animations in settings.
Stats week-over-week — Config → Stats → Activity with the week period shows active bookmarks this week vs last week (with % change).
Add to home screen — panel under HyprMode in Advanced with platform steps and an install button when the browser offers beforeinstallprompt.
Reset all dashboard promos — Tours & onboarding includes one button to clear every discoverability promo (search, G+jump, feature tips) via dashboard-promo-registry.js.

Settings defaults — showIcons / showConfigButton semantics aligned across Go and JS; JSON migrations no longer write false for missing bool keys; buttonBarPosition stays server-authoritative; fresh-install defaults match Essentials visibility.
Health bulk feedback — bulk delete and favicon refresh report partial failures with a summary toast instead of failing silently.

Weather location promo — when browser geolocation is blocked but weather uses browser location, a one-time dashboard promo links to Config → General. Reset from Tours & onboarding → Reset weather location promo.
Extension bookmark-form sync — npm run sync:extension-bookmark-form copies static/js/bookmark-form/* into extension/bookmark-form/ so the extension stays aligned with the dashboard form modules.
Help & manual — README, MANUAL, and this release note updated for side-rail tag cloud, G + P, grouped toasts, stats week-over-week, PWA install helper, and promo registry.
Side-rail i18n — button-bar position, tooltips, and cheat-sheet layout strings in EN / NL / DE / FR.
